subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + minimal evidence checklist
body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + minimal evidence checklist

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. As we prepare for your security review, could you please share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report you’re comfortable providing and any associated bridge letter (if the report end date doesn’t cover our target production window)? To keep the initial ask low-friction, we typically request the report PDF and 4–6 quick evidence items that auditors commonly expect.

To make this as easy as possible, I attached a short template (SOC2_Request_Template.docx) mapping what we usually need. If you prefer, we can accept a secure Drive link or an SFTP drop.

Minimal starter list (examples you can use or substitute with equivalents):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + Bridge letter if the reporting window misses our production cutover
- List of active user accounts for administrative roles (CSV export or screenshot)
- Recent access log sample (1–2 days; redacted PII OK)
- Change control evidence for a recent release (PR link or change log + approval screenshot)
- High-level network diagram or control owner contact

If you’d rather send a single package, we’re fine with that — otherwise the four items above let us move quickly. Also attaching a short PDF that explains our bridge-letter expectations if helpful.

One-line template reply you can use if you want to delegate:

"Hi Rafael — we’ll share the report and four starter artifacts by EOD Thursday; sending via secure Drive link. — Liam"

Appreciate it,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Request_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), redwood-bridge-letter-options.pdf (application/pdf)

-------------------------
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-audit@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + minimal evidence checklist

Thanks Rafael —

We can share the Type II report and a bridge letter. I want to confirm two quick items before we package things: 
1) Audit period you need covered (our current Type II covers 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31).
2) Level of redaction allowed for access logs (we typically remove patient identifiers for PHI environments).

We’ll aim to send the report PDF and the four starter artifacts by EOD Friday; if you need sooner, let me know and I’ll escalate.

— Liam
Head of Security Operations
Acme Health

-------------------------
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + minimal evidence checklist

Appreciate the quick reply, Liam. Short answers below to help you package the materials: 

1) Audit period: our procurement team is aiming for coverage that includes the production cutover on 2028-02-15. If your Type II ends 2027-12-31, a bridge letter that explicitly states controls continued through 2028-02-15 is sufficient for our intake window. The bridge letter can be brief.

2) Logs: redaction of patient identifiers is fine. For access logs we primarily need timestamp, actor identity (user or service account id), resource acted on, and action type (read/write/auth). If you can provide a 48-hour sample and a short sentence describing sampling method, that covers our audit intake.

If helpful, here’s a suggested two-line bridge letter snippet you can copy into your legal/security template: 

"The SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 remains representative of Acme Health’s control environment through 2028-02-15. No material changes to the described controls occurred during this interval."

Quick internal note: Vanessa — please keep an eye on whether we need an NDA addendum for log samples. Marissa — can you confirm whether procurement needs a separate DocuSign request for bridge-letter acceptance?

Thanks —
Rafael

-------------------------
From: acme-audit@acmehealth.com <acme-audit@acmehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + minimal evidence checklist

Hello Rafael —

We’re assembling the package now and will upload to the secure Drive link you provided. Expected contents:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (PDF) using the suggested wording (we’ll add a stamp from our external auditor)
- Admin user list (CSV, redacted columns for PII)
- 48-hour access log sample (CSV, redacted)
- Change control evidence (PR links + release notes PDF)

We will mark any items that require an NDA/DP agreement at the top-level manifest. Expected upload: Friday 2028-03-16 16:00 PST.

Best,
Acme Audit Team

---
Notes: Follow-up actions created in HubSpot (ACM-8742). Rafael to confirm if procurement requires DocuSign acknowledgement. If bridge letter is stamped by auditor, mark "has_stamped_bridge" on the intake manifest.
